title: Sun
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- rays -->
    <g fill='#FFB300' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='1.5'>
      <polygon points='50,2 54,16 46,16'/>
      <polygon points='50,98 54,84 46,84'/>
      <polygon points='2,50 16,54 16,46'/>
      <polygon points='98,50 84,54 84,46'/>
      <polygon points='16,16 26,24 20,30'/>
      <polygon points='84,84 74,76 80,70'/>
      <polygon points='84,16 74,24 80,30'/>
      <polygon points='16,84 26,76 20,70'/>
    </g>
    <!-- sun body -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#FFD740' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- inner glow -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#FFCA28'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8F00'/>
    <ellipse cx='61' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8F00'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#5D4037'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#5D4037'/>
    <!-- eye shine -->
    <circle cx='44.5' cy='44.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='58.5' cy='44.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M43,55 Q50,62 57,55' fill='none' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
